- Auto clicker (Toolkit, and a Quick Settings tile): a floating bar with − / + for how many spots (1 to 10), start / stop, the speed (0.1 to 5 s) and close; each spot is a target mark you drag to where the tap should land, and while it runs the marks let the touch through. Needs the Pulse · Auto clicker accessibility service (it reads nothing from the screen). The tile opens the accessibility settings until the service is on, then shows the bar, then starts and stops.
